script_text: Brace yourself, because the cosmos is about to violently shake the foundation of your Water element this week. Thursday through Sunday sees Venus sextile Saturn in your 10th House, transforming a career block into a beautiful love breakthrough, while Mercury conjunct Sun improves partnership communication.
